_doc: Master result inventory for the graph-filtered conformal prediction submission. Each record describes one reported artifact. Status legend: 'exact' = numbers come straight from manifest aggregation with no manual edit; 'approx' = number rounded for typesetting; 'post-processed' = derived (for example, relative-width percentages); 'manually edited' = presentation-only editing on top of generated values.

artifacts.caption_or_claim_text: Filtered conformal prediction. A frozen filter emits a one-step mean and covariance; calibration scores are squared Mahalanobis residuals; the empirical (1-α)-quantile defines a prediction ellipsoid.
artifacts.generation_script_or_notebook: manual diagram (vector source not in repo); png exported from jpg
